SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY
Date June 8, 1931
No. S. B. D. 24645
late J. L. M.

Sir,

At 3 p.m. on June 8, I called upon Mr. Blackburn
at H.B.M. Consulate-General and obtained a clear under-
standing that any statement taken from Sung Li Sung would
not be subsequently used or asked for as a deposition in
Court but was required simply to aid Mr. Scott, vice-consul,
in enquiries at the scene of the shooting, etc.

At 3.30 p.m. together with Mr. Paul P. Y. Ru,
I called upon Procurator Kuo Wei at the Special District
Court. After consulting the Chief Procurator, Mr. Kuo
Wei decided that he would not attend at St. Luke's Hospi-
tal when Mr. Scott and the Police were questioning the
wounded soldier, but would act independently if necessity
arose.

At 4.20 p.m. together with Mr. Scott I proceeded
to St. Luke's Hospital and met Procurator Kuo Wei and his
writer leaving the institution. The Procurator had spoken
to the wounded soldier but discreet enquiries amongst the
male nurses in the ward showed that the interview lasted
only a few minutes and not even as much information as
contained in the statement taken by S. I. O'Neill was ob-
tained by the Court officials. Subsequently, the wounded
soldier in Mr. Scott's presence was questioned but nothing
of importance could be learned owing to his semi-conscious
state. He is badly wounded in the abdomen and in addi-
tion very thin, almost emaciated. There is no reason
to believe (the result of enquiries are to the contrary)
that he was warned not to reply to the Police or any fo-
reigners. Mr. Ru is in touch with the Procurator's writer
in order to confirm the report of the hospital nurses.

Mr. Scott left for Soochow and vicinity to-day,
but if the wounded soldier recovers sufficiently to make a

上海公共租界工部局警务处登记簿
日期 1931年6月8日
编号 S. B. D. 24645
前 J. L. M.

先生，

6月8日下午3时，我拜访了英国驻沪总领事馆的布莱克本（Blackburn）先生，并达成明确谅解：从宋利生（Sung Li Sung）处取得的任何陈述，随后均不会作为法庭证词使用或索取，而仅是为了协助副领事斯科特（Scott）先生在枪击现场等地进行调查。

下午3时30分，我与鲁保罗（Paul P. Y. Ru）先生一同前往特区法院拜访检察官郭维（Kuo Wei）。在与首席检察官商议后，郭维先生决定，当斯科特先生和警方讯问受伤士兵时，他不会前往圣路加医院（St. Luke's Hospital），但若有必要，他将独立采取行动。

下午4时20分，我与斯科特先生一同前往圣路加医院，遇见正离开该院的检察官郭维及其书记员。检察官已与受伤士兵交谈，但通过对病房男护士的谨慎查访显示，此次谈话仅持续了几分钟，法院官员所获得的信息甚至不如 S. I. 奥尼尔（S. I. O'Neill）所取陈述中包含的内容多。随后，在斯科特先生在场的情况下对受伤士兵进行了讯问，但由于其处于半昏迷状态，未能获悉任何重要情况。他腹部受重伤，此外身体非常消瘦，几乎骨瘦如柴。没有理由相信（调查结果恰恰相反）他曾受到警告不要回答警方或任何外国人的提问。鲁先生正与检察官的书记员保持联系，以核实医院护士的报告。

斯科特先生今日前往苏州及周边地区，但如果受伤士兵康复到足以作出

31/

Inquest No.4854(Hongkew)held at the Public Mortuary on the 8-6-31
before Procurator Koh Wei on the body of a male Chinese named Li Kue Zang
age 20 who died in St.Lukes Hospital at 1 p.m.7-6-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S.D. REC.S.
No. S. D. D. 2464.
cte 10 - 6 - 31.

Proceedings

7/Inspt.White:-At 1-15p.m.7-6-31 a telephone message was received
from St.Lukes Hospt.that a Soldier had just died there. Inquires were made
& it was ascertained that the deceased with another Soldier were admitted
to the Hospt.at 8-50a.m.2-6-31 suffering from gun-shot wounds. It appears
that the 2 Soldiers were Military guards on the railway & on the night of
the 1st.& 2nd.June they were patrolling the line near An-ding in the Yuin
san district when some persons or persons at present unknown opened fire
on them & both were wounded.the place is outside the Settlements limits
so the Police have not been able to inquiry fully into the case & we do
know at present whether it was Chinese or Foreigners who fired the shots.
We have communicated with the Chinese Military Authorities but have not
yet received any reply.

According to the newspapers there are Foreigners involved in it,but
that is not yet verified.

There was no bullet found in the body of the deceased,but there is a bull
et in the body of the other man, but he has not yet been operated on
him owing to his dangerous condition.

I ask the Court to have the body temporarily detained at the Mortuary

Verdict:-I find that deceased died from injuries received from gun-shot
wounds. Body to be temporarily detained pending the arrival of relatives
from An-ding.

N.H.

第4854号死因研讯（虹口）于1931年6月8日在公立殓房举行，由检察官郭维（Koh Wei）主持，针对一名名为李国章（Li Kue Zang）的20岁中国男性死者遗体进行，该死者于1931年6月7日下午1时在圣路加医院死亡

上海公共租界工部局警务处
及特别分部记录 S.
编号 S. D. D. 2464.
日期 1931年6月10日

程序记录

7/怀特（White）巡官：- 1931年6月7日下午1时15分，接到圣路加医院电话通知，称一名士兵刚刚在该院死亡。经查询查明，死者与另一名士兵于1931年6月2日上午8时50分因枪伤入院。据悉，这两名士兵是铁路军事警卫，在6月1日和2日夜间，他们在尹山（Yuin san，音译）地区安亭（An-ding，音译）附近巡逻线路时，遭到目前身份不明的一人或多人开枪射击，两人均受伤。事发地点在租界界限之外，因此警方无法对该案进行全面调查，目前我们也不清楚开枪者是中国人还是外国人。我们已与中国军方当局取得联系，但尚未收到任何回复。

据报纸报道，有外国人卷入此事，但这尚未得到证实。

死者体内未发现子弹，但另一人体内有一颗子弹，不过由于后者病情危重，尚未对其进行手术。

我请求法庭将遗体暂时扣留于殓房。

裁决：- 我认定死者死于枪伤所致伤害。遗体暂时扣留，等待来自安亭（An-ding）的亲属到达。

N.H.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
Hongkew Station
Date June 8, 1931

Subject (in full) Inquest proceedings on deceased Chinese soldier named Li Kuo Zung

Made by S.I. White and Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕

Sir:
At the Public Mortuary in the forenoon of the 8th inst.,
Procurator Kuo Wei presided at an inquest on deceased Chinese
soldier named Li Kuo Zung, who died in St Luke's Hospital at 1.15
p.m. on the 7th June 1931 and returned the following verdict:-
Death due to injuries received from gun shot wounds.
Body to be detained temporarily in the Mortuary pending arrival
of representative from Wei Ting.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,

S I.

A.C. Political Branch.

REPORT

Hongkew Station,
Date June 7, 1931.

Subject (in full) Death of Chinese Soldier at St. Luke's Hospital.

Made by D.S.I. O'Neill Forwarded by A/C.D.I. Knight

Sir,

At 5 p.m. June 7, 1931, accompanied by C.D.C. 16 I visited
St. Luke's Hospital where it was ascertained that the Chinese
Soldier who had died there at 1 p.m. of even date was one of a
party of soldiers who had been in shooting affray near Quinsan
on June 1st. Death certificate as follows:-
Cause of Death: "Gunshot wound of abdomen - Rupture
of left kidney and spleen" Signed Dr. T.T.Waung,M.D.
The deceased name is Li Kue Zung ( ), age 20, who was
brought to the hospital with a companion also suffering from
bullet wounds by other Chinese Soldier at 8.30 a.m. 2/6/31.
A short statement was taken from the second soldier who is
seriously wounded.
Arrangement are being made in this station for the inquest
to be held on the deceased soldier.

I am,
Copy of statement attached, Sir,

Ll Wm. Oneil
D.S.I.

Knight a/c.o.
S.D. i/c..

D.D.O. "C" R.C

先生，

1931年6月7日下午5时，我在第16号华捕探目（C.D.C. 16）陪同下访问了圣路加医院，经查实，于当日下午1时在该院死亡的中国士兵，是6月1日在昆山（Quinsan）附近参与枪战的一队士兵中的一员。死亡证明如下：-
死因：“腹部枪伤 - 左肾及脾破裂” 签署人：T.T. Waung 医学博士。
死者姓名为李国宗（Li Kue Zung）（ ），年龄20岁，于1931年6月2日上午8时30分由其他中国士兵与其同样遭受枪伤的同伴一同送往医院。
我们从身受重伤的第二名士兵处取得了一份简短陈述。
本站正在安排对已故士兵举行死因研讯。

此致，
附陈述副本，先生，

Ll Wm. Oneil

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
========================
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
================================
The following is the statement of Sung Li Sung ( 沈利生 )
native of Changchow taken by me D.S. Moore
at St Luke's Hospital on the June 7, 1931 and interpreted by ~~D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa~~

My name is Sung Li Sung, aged 28, native of Changchow
( 常州 ) and a member of the 4th Comapny, 1st Battalion, 1st
Regiment of the Military Police. On June 1st 1931 one Company
of the Military Police left their Headquarters at Quinsan on
duty as a railway search party and of which I was a member.
Later we divided into small parties of four men and my group
proceeded towards Chen-I ( 正儀 ) Station between Quinsan and
Weiting ( 唯亭 ). At about 9.30 p.m. when near Chen-I, I was
struck in the chest by bullets fired by "tufei" and fell
unconscious. I did not actually see who fired the shots
so am unable to state whether he was a Chinese or a foreigner.

以下为沈利生（Sung Li Sung）的陈述，由我，副督察摩尔（D.S. Moore），于1931年6月7日在圣路加医院采集，并由 ~~督察顾宝华（D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa）~~ 翻译

我叫沈利生，现年28岁，籍贯常州（Changchow），系宪兵第一团第一营第四连成员。1931年6月1日，一连宪兵离开昆山（Quinsan）总部，执行铁路搜查任务，我是其中一员。后来我们分成四人一组的小队，我所在的小组向位于昆山和唯亭（Weiting）之间的正仪（Chen-I）车站进发。晚上9时30分左右，在靠近正仪时，我被“土匪”（tufei）发射的子弹击中胸部，随即昏迷。我并未亲眼看到是谁开的枪，因此无法说明他是中国人还是外国人。

我名沈利生。年廿八歲。常州人。在崑山充當憲兵營
第一團第一營第四連兵士。
於年六月一号 我們一連兵士由崑山區管部出發。
我六點內。心即分散四人一班。吾班即向正儀沿鐵路
巡查。正儀站立崑山唯亭之間。五加付字許將近
正儀。我被土匪擊而即昏迷。我並未看見
何人開鎗。故不能說開鎗人是否華人或外國
人。

西探摩亞

ST. LUKE'S HOSPITAL
AMERICAN CHURCH MISSION
69 SEWARD ROAD
SHANGHAI, CHINA

June 5, 1931.

To Whom It May Concern,

This is to certify that Li Kuo Chai ( 李國才 ),
a soldier, was admitted here on June 2, 1931, for penetrating
Gun-shot wound of the abdomen, damaging his left kidney and spleen,
which were removed on the following day. He has slightly improved
but is still in a serious condition;
That Shen Li-Shang ( 沈利聲 ), also a soldier, was
admitted at the same time with a gun-shot wound of the right side
of the chest. His condition is very serious. He has also a Pene-
trating wound of the right arm, which, apparently, was inflicted
by the same bullet.

E. Y. Kau, M. D.

兹证明士兵李国才（Li Kuo Chai）于1931年6月2日入院，诊断为腹部穿透性枪伤，损伤其左肾及脾脏，上述器官已于次日切除。其病情略有改善，但仍处于严重状态；

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. B. REGISTER
Vo. S. B. D. 2464.
Date 5 - 6 - 31.

Translation of a telegram received from Quinsan
by the Railway Police Headquarters, Shanghai North
Station on June 2, 1931.

------

At 11 p.m. the Military Police patrolling the
railroad encountered about 3 li west of Chen I
Station several persons and exchanged shots, re-
sulting in the wounding of two members of the
Military Police.

Subsequently in the vicinity of the spot, one
gun was found and one Russian in possession of one
pistol was taken into custody and detained at
the Military Police Battalion Headquarters at
Quinsan.

上海公共租界工部局
刑事与特别处登记簿
编号 S. B. D. 2464.
日期 1931年6月5日。

1931年6月2日由上海北站铁路警察总部收到的来自昆山的电报译文。

------

晚上11时，巡逻铁路的宪兵在正仪（Chen I）车站以西约三里处遭遇数人并发生交火，导致两名宪兵受伤。

随后在该地点附近，发现枪支一支，并逮捕了一名持有手枪的俄国人，将其拘留在昆山宪兵营总部。

page_data.en:
Extract from the Morning Translation of
June 3, 1931.

------

**Russian Arrested for killing Railway Police**

The Shun Pao and other local newspapers pu-
blish the following reports : -

At 10 p.m. June 1, three railway policemen
were fired on by a Russian near the Wei Ding
Station between Soochow and Quinshan on the Shanghai
Nanking Railway. The Russian was in possession of
two loaded pistols, holding one in each hand. On
the approach of the Railway Police, he fired causing
serious injuries to two of the policemen, after which
he made good his escape. As a result of a thorough
search, the Russian, who is named "Si Sz Ke Tuh Chu Lee",
was arrested between Quinshan and Wei Ding at dawn
yesterday.

|| Both wounded policemen died in the St. Luke's
Hospital, Shanghai, yesterday.

D.I. Ross.
For inquiries & report please
H.R. 3/6.

1931年6月3日《晨间译报》摘录。

------

**俄国人因杀害铁路警察被捕**

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：-

6月1日晚上10时，在上海至南京铁路苏州与昆山之间的唯定（Wei Ding，音译）车站附近，三名铁路警察遭一名俄国人开枪射击。该俄国人双手各持一把已上膛的手枪。当铁路警察接近时，他开枪射击，造成两名警察重伤，随后逃脱。经过彻底搜查，该名名为“Si Sz Ke Tuh Chu Lee”（音译）的俄国人于昨日黎明时分在昆山与唯定之间被捕。

|| 两名受伤警察昨日均在上海圣路加医院死亡。

罗斯（Ross）督察。
如需查询及报告请联络
H.R. 6月3日。
